mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCER ( producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{producerId}, #{userNo}, #{bizNo}, #{bizName}, #{bizAddr}, #{bizPhone}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccountNo}, #{accountHolder}, #{isVerified}, #{verifiedAt}, #{rejectReason}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT producer_id AS producerId, user_no AS userNo, biz_no AS bizNo, biz_name AS bizName, biz_addr AS bizAddr, biz_phone AS bizPhone, bank_name AS bankName, bank_account_no AS bankAccountNo, account_holder AS accountHolder, is_verified AS isVerified, verified_at AS verifiedAt, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_date AS createdDate, updated_date AS updatedDate FROM PRODUCER WHERE user_no = #{userNo}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}

SELECT producer_id, user_no, biz_no, biz_name, biz_addr, biz_phone, bank_name, bank_account_no, account_holder, is_verified, verified_at, reject_reason, created_date, updated_date FROM PRODUCER WHERE is_verified = 'N' ORDER BY created_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'Y', verified_at = SYSDATE, reject_reason = NULL, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
UPDATE PRODUCER SET is_verified = 'N', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE producer_id = #{producerId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, -- 상품명 컬럼 이름: name d.stock_qty AS stockQty, -- 실제 재고 10 AS safetyStockQty -- 임시 안전 재고 기준 (예: 10개) FROM PRODUCT p JOIN PRODUCT_DETAIL d ON d.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.producer_id = #{producerId} AND d.stock_qty < 10 ORDER BY d.stock_qty ASC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,
d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus,
o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone,
p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND oi.order_status IN ('A1')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,
d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus,
o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone,
p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND oi.order_status IN ('R', 'C')
ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,
d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus,
o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone,
p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE DELIVERY d SET d.delivery_status = #{deliveryStatus}, d.updated_date = SYSDATE, d.shipped_at = CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus} = 'SHIPPED' AND d.shipped_at IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE d.shipped_at END, d.delivered_at = CASE WHEN #{deliveryStatus} = 'DELIVERED' AND d.delivered_at IS NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE d.delivered_at END WHERE d.order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id WHERE oi.order_item_id = d.order_item_id AND pr.producer_id = #{producerId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRUNC(o.order_date) AS salesDate, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND o.order_status IN ('PAID', 'DELIVERED') GROUP BY TRUNC(o.order_date) ORDER BY salesDate

SELECT oi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_date AS orderDate, o.order_status AS orderStatus,
d.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus,
o.receiver_name AS receiverName, o.receiver_phone AS receiverPhone,
p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName,
oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.price_at_order AS priceAtOrder, oi.line_total_amount AS lineTotalAmount
FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN DELIVERY d ON d.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND oi.order_status IN ('PAID', 'DELIVERED') ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC, oi.order_item_id DESC

SELECT t.productId, t.productName, t.totalQuantity, t.totalAmount FROM ( SELECT p.product_id AS productId, oi.product_name AS productName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS totalQuantity, SUM(oi.line_total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM ORDERS_ITEM oi JOIN PRODUCT p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN PRODUCER pr ON p.producer_id = pr.producer_id JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE pr.producer_id = #{producerId} AND TRUNC(o.order_date, 'MM') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND o.order_status IN ('PAID', 'DELIVERED') GROUP BY p.product_id, oi.product_name ORDER BY totalQuantity DESC ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT_DETAIL pd SET pd.unit_name = #{unitName}, pd.price = #{price}, pd.stock_qty = #{stockQty}, pd.updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE pd.detail_id = #{detailId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.product_id = pd.product_id AND p.producer_id = #{producerId} )
